sv.title: Bombhot mot hundratals skolor i Danmark och Tyskland
sv.summary: Hundratals skolor i Danmark och Tyskland har bombhotats via mejl under måndagen. Dansk polis manar till lugn.

en.title: Bomb threats against hundreds of schools in Denmark and Germany
en.summary: Hundreds of schools in Denmark and Germany received bomb threats by email on Monday. Danish police urge calm.
